name: The Mews
description: A Warm Welcome Awaits You At The Mews

The Mews consists of seven, purpose-built, self-contained Residential Bungalows with an independent living feel. The Service offers bespoke and person-specific care and support services to people with Mental Health conditions, learning disabilities, physical disabilities and complex needs. The service aims to encourage, support and empower people to remain as independent as possible within their own living environment.
Primelifes ultimate goal is to provide a high quality, safe, person-centred, friendly and professional service to all our clients.
Accommodation and Services

The Mews consists of seven, purpose built, self contained Residential Bungalows with an independent living feel. The Service offers bespoke and person specific care & support services to people with Mental Health conditions, learning disabilities, physical disabilities and complex needs. The aim of the service is to encourage, support and empower people to remain as independent as possible within their own living environment.

The Mews offers an onsite core Team of highly skilled and trained Support Workers, along with a Registered Manager, who will be based in the office onsite with the bungalows. However, within each individual bungalow we can also offer a bespoke and individually staffed support team for you, built around each individuals needs from assessments and funding.
All 7 bungalows are mobility friendly, with wider door frames, hallway and spacious rooms to enable access with ease.
Activities

Our residents will be supported to create their own person specific activities planner based around their own individual interests, hobbies and any groups they may wish to participate in. These may be for leisure, employment and/or education purposes. Alongside this the service will also offer ‘joint Service activities’, where residents may wish to take part in with staff and other clients within the bungalows as a whole service. This is each residents choice as to whether theyd like to participate in.
Prospective Resident

Prior to moving into The Mews all our residents are offered an individual care plan, assessing their wishes, choices and needs. Bespoke Care and Support will be built and structured on a person specific basis, basing the service around the persons Health and Social needs. Our residents will be at the absolute centre of the bespoke service created for them. Ensuring they are involved and in control of the care & support package built for them.

description: Oval House provides for 22 clients whose needs are based on their mental health with a view to preparing them for a future living in the community.
Accommodation provided is finished to a luxury standard and are all single rooms.
Key Features
Oval House is based next to Braunstone Park just a short walk from local shops and amenities and approximately 3 miles from the city of Leicester.
All single-room accommodation.
Luxury kitchen/dinner
Large meeting room
Large, landscaped garden with smoking shelter and flower beds.
No smoking or vaping building
High-standard bathrooms
Digital TV aerial points in every room.
Accommodation
Oval House offers single-room accommodation of a good size. All rooms have a sink and medication cabinet in the room to promote independence.
Rooms are arranged into small flats comprised of between 4-6 bedrooms. All flats have a luxury kitchen dinner, and bathrooms finished to a high standard throughout.
Services
The service at Oval House enables clients to receive support with their mental health needs.
Staff offer support to build independent living skills with a view to independent living within the community. We aim to help clients achieve their goals and ambitions.
Activities
Clients will be encouraged to pursue their chosen activities and will be supported to do so.

Oval House staff will support clients in learning everyday living skills such as cooking, cleaning, laundry, and budgeting, with the aim of preparing clients to lead fulfilling lives when living in the community.
Location
Oval House is based in Braunstone, which is a town in Leicester, approximately 3 miles to the town centre but a very short walk to a main and regular bus route.
There is good access to local shops and Oval House is on the doorstep of Braunstone Park and local to Western Park, so there is plenty of opportunities for fresh air and exercise.
Prospective Clients
Prospective clients of Oval House will be encouraged to come and view all vacant accommodations.
In advance of a place being offered an individual assessment will take place to ensure the client’s needs and choices can be met and discuss how this will be structured.
The emphasis is on the involvement of the individual to focus on developing their personal skills and regaining a sense of purpose and independence.
Our Team
Oval House employs approximately 20 staff all of which are trained in key aspects of support to ensure the provision of a safe, quality service to our client group.
Staff at Oval House are trained in specialist subjects, specifically aimed at supporting client’s needs.

Our staff benefit from training programmes, supported by our Quality Matters Team with an emphasis on qualifications and internal promotion. Full details of the training programme can be obtained from the Home Manager.

Oakdene provides an in-house monthly activity programme including trips and outings to places of interest chosen by residents living at Oakdene.

All residents are encouraged to be involved in aspects of the home such as activity planning, menu planning and decisions around décor etc. All residents are encouraged to attend the resident’s meetings to discuss these issues.

Oakdene provides one-to-one activities with residents planning their activity programme, developed for them to be as independent as they wish. We assist those who wish to work towards furthering their independent skills, such as cooking, budgeting, and maintaining their personal space.
All residents are encouraged to make their personal space their own by bringing in their personal effects.
Location

Oakdene is located in North Nottinghamshire, close to the centre of Mansfield, with good access to local shops and amenities including hairdressers, takeaways, pubs and restaurants, GP and local parks all within walking distance.
Prospective Residents

Prospective residents of Oakdene will be encouraged to view all available vacant accommodations and visit for a trial day. In advance of a place being offered, an individual care plan assessment focusing on individual choice and needs will be structured, with an emphasis on the involvement of the individual to focus on developing their skills and regaining a sense of purpose and independence.
Our Team
Oakdene employs approximately 30 staff all of whom are trained in the key aspects of care delivery, to ensure the provision of a safe, quality service to our client group.

Our staff also benefit from a vocational training programme and are regularly supported by our Quality Matters Team to embark upon specialist mental health training, with an emphasis on internal promotion and staff development.
Full details of the training undertaken by our staff can be obtained from the Home Manager.

name: Tanworth Court
description: A bespoke, newly built nursing home in the popular district of Shirley, Solihull with smart living accommodation for 60 people. This brand new home has been designed and built by Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council and operated by Prime Life, for local residents to feel part of their community.

Tanworth Court is able to support people in both a residential capacity and for those with additional nursing needs. The home itself has 4 separate bedroom wings stretching out from a central atrium downstairs and an airy gallery landing upstairs.

The central atrium features a modern hair salon and beauty room, an open plan Bistro for informal dining and the main dining area for residents to enjoy. It is envisaged that friends and family plus members of the local community will use this area to meet and enjoy the facilities together.

The bedrooms are all spacious, wheelchair accessible and have their own ‘front door’. The rooms are fitted with en-suite bathrooms including accessible showers and high-quality furniture including high/low beds for additional safety. The décor is classic using modern colours with flat-screen TV’s provided as standard in all rooms. Lower level windows provide views to the outside, with many rooms overlooking the lovely garden.
Tanworth Court is designed to provide accommodation for those people who wish to maintain their independence whilst also offering a higher level of assistance should it be required.

Generous individualised corridors lead to seating areas and lounges where residents can sit and chat, entertain their families and friends or just rest a while watching the world go by. Lounges include fully fitted tea bar areas, comfy seating, flat-screen TV’s and again full-length windows to bring the outside in.
Secure, landscaped gardens provide a relaxing space for both residents and their families to spend time together in the fresh air, making us of the plentiful all-weather garden furniture.

name: Birch Green
address: Ivydale, Birch Green, Skelmersdale, Lancashire, WN8 6RS
description: Purpose-built and state-of-the-art, Birch Green offers residents a comfortable, homely environment.

All our rooms are single, and some with ensuite facilities are exceptionally spacious. The home has been tastefully furnished to the highest standards, but there is still plenty of space to add personal touches by bringing favourite furniture, photographs and pictures.

The staff happily assist people we support in transforming their private room into their home during their stay. All the people we support also have access to separate lounges and dining rooms, where they can entertain their visitors as they choose. Therapeutic but homely, designed for care yet beautifully appointed,

Birch Green Care Home provides an atmosphere that is both supportive and purposeful, aiming to strike a good balance between appropriate stimulation and calm. Birch Green offers a positive lifestyle choice, a choice for your care, your way. Our dedicated, highly skilled staff provide a wide range of high-quality person-centred services for adults and older people with a wide range of needs including:
Care for adults and older people.
Nursing, residential and respite care.
Specialist care for people with dementia and complex healthcare requirements.

Our aim is to provide the people we care for and support with a positive and personalised lifestyle. Offering you choices and the ability to maintain control of your life is central to the service we offer at Birch Green. We pride ourselves on going the extra mile for people we care for and support.

In addition to an excellent team of nurses and support workers, have a dedicated and committed team of lifestyle support/activities, housekeeping, catering and administration staff, all of whom provide an essential role in making your life at Birch Green as comfortable and positive as possible. Activities are key to life for our residents and our dedicated lifestyle team runs a packed programme from visits to museums and parks to craft and musical entertainment. We understand that top-quality care and support can only be delivered by well trained, kind and caring staff. Hence we recognise our staff as our most valuable asset, and we invest significantly in their development, both as individuals and as effective teams. Examples of this include having our own dedicated qualified nurse, who provides training and coaching to the staff team to ensure staff can provide the highest standards of personalised care and support. We understand the importance of health and nutrition and ensure that healthy menu choices prepared by our resident chefs are always available.

name: Springhill
address: Springhill Care Home, Springhill House, Fairfield Street, Accrington, Lancashire, BB5 0LD
description: Standing in four acres of landscaped grounds with spectacular views of the surrounding Lancashire countryside, Springhill Care Home provides top quality luxury en-suite accommodation, also personalised care and support for adults and older people with a variety of needs.

Our services include nursing care provided by our team of highly-skilled Registered Nurses, residential care, rehabilitation, (perhaps following a stay in hospital), respite, and daycare services. For people with more specific needs, we provide a wide range of specialist services including our highly acclaimed dementia and end of life services.
The home is divided into four areas of service on two floors, providing nursing, residential and specialist care for adults and older people.

Bedrooms in the general nursing and residential care sections of the home are all single, with en-suite facilities, generously proportioned, and are well-appointed. Rooms can also be personalised to suit each individual.

Therapeutic but homely, designed for care, yet beautifully appointed, Springhill Care Home has been designed from the outset to provide an atmosphere that is both supportive and purposeful, aiming to strike a good balance between appropriate stimulation and calm.

While physically attached to Springhill Care Home, the care centre is a separate dedicated facility, complete with its own entrance. The care centre provides a cheerful, bright and modern environment, designed to promote a more person-centred style of residential care & support.

The care centre comprises five smaller self-contained suites of between eight and ten bedrooms, with each suite having its own communal spaces. The self-contained suites enable us to support people at various stages of their memory loss.

All bedrooms are spacious and luxuriously appointed, with private en-suite facilities including wet room showers. Each suite comprises an open plan lounge and dining room area with lifestyle kitchens for resident and relatives’ use.

Our staff team has been carefully selected for their personal values and ability to provide care and support for people with memory loss. Springhill offers a positive lifestyle choice, a choice for your care, your way.
Easily accessible from Accrington town centre, Springhill Care Home is on a main bus route.

name: Vinegar House
amenities: Digital TV aerial points in every room
description: Vinegar House situated in Derby City is a 13-bed care home catering for adults under the age of 65 suffering from various aspects of mental health illness.

We promote a small and friendly environment in which to live. The home has a modern and cosy feel as we actively aim to avoid an institutional style. All of our rooms are en-suite and we have 5 specific rooms, which are targeted more at semi-independent living for Service Users who have been identified as having the potential to further develop their living skills or a psychological process to ultimately support them moving on.

These rooms include an additional small kitchenettes equipped with sinks, micro waves and fridge, the intention being to support Service Users who have the potential to prepare their own snacks etc. The reality of the above is that few service users actually prepare their own meals preferring the quieter aspect of the rooms, and the more teaching focus of the kitchen in the main house. However this remains an option available to us as and when anyone shows the potential or desire.

We believe it to be important that people with mental ill health who have invariably spent lengthy periods in institutions are allowed to experience what may be perceived as normal living practices and social outlets without undue pressure from potentially harmful influences that may be more prevalent in certain locations within a city environment.
